scope: The complete local scripted Castaway freshwater journey, strict typed action boundary, three discriminating negative paths, retained causal trace, and fresh-process replay from versioned durable inputs at the observed World Substrate revision.

test_selection.changed_boundary: M1 replay now reconstructs from a versioned serialized initial snapshot, explicit registry/content identities, and commands in a fresh process; untrusted registered parameters and every evidence gate fail closed.
test_selection.failure_hypothesis: The runtime could coerce malformed JSON types, depend on hidden in-memory initial state, accept a mismatched retained trace, or report PASS from a rejected probe or incomplete maturity receipt.
test_selection.discriminating_probe: Reject coercible string, float, boolean, list, and numeric action parameters; execute the 22-command journey; load only its committed snapshot, registry/content identity, and commands in a fresh process; compare full events and final hash; exercise all negative paths; and run the complete receipt and project gates.
test_selection.decision_if_pass: Reaffirm M1 promotion with durable replay and fail-closed evidence, leaving M2 at its existing human authorization boundary.
test_selection.decision_if_fail: Reopen M1 and repair the first strict-input, snapshot, identity, replay, evidence-generation, or receipt-validation failure before any policy integration.

journey.starting_state: Two colocated living actors, one clay pot, one metal cup, a finite pathogen-bearing freshwater source, a finite-fuel fire, explicit carrying state, and registered neutral rules/processes.
journey.input: The scripted controller selects discovered fill, heat, unheat, pour, drink, take, and give actions while the runner advances fifteen deterministic ticks; separate engines receive the three negative envelopes.
steps: Verify the committed transfer trace still matches the executable positive probe.
Compare final tick, actors, vessels, physical ledger, fuel, and vessel identity with the pinned donor checkpoint.
Reject registered envelopes whose string or integer parameters use coercible JSON types.
Start a fresh process, load the committed versioned initial snapshot, select the pinned registry/content identity, replay all 22 commands, and require identical material hash and events.
Submit an overfill and require atomic precondition_failed with exact replay.
Submit a valid unregistered pressure envelope and require atomic unsupported_action with exact replay.
Submit a malformed registered fill envelope and require atomic invalid_action with exact replay.
Prove a rejected probe cannot be encoded as canonical PASS evidence and that incomplete or false-green maturity receipts fail validation.
Run the self-contained project gate, 32 tests, Ruff, and mypy at the same revision.

surface_observations.observation: The self-contained project command passed all retained probes, fresh-process replay, complete receipt validation, and 32 runtime tests.
The positive semantic checkpoint and ledger matched; strict typed-parameter regressions and all three negative statuses passed atomically; every replay was exact.

A fresh process loaded the versioned initial snapshot and pinned registry/content identity from the committed trace, replayed all 22 commands, and reproduced the retained material hash and complete event sequence.
The comparison used the committed fixture derived from Castaway revision da5ccb46fa536505bbc0235a4157c648c8bb4bcb.
The compact human review exposes the final state, conservation/treatment results, identity result, replay result, all negative outcomes, and derives PASS from the accepted machine payload.

outcome.observed_result: The complete M1 scripted journey, strict input boundary, fail-closed evidence gates, and fresh-process replay passed at revision 4c3303828b7c9b97e22a806caa404306f8616f7a.
outcome.state_change: The clay pot ended at tick 15 owned by Friday with 728 ml of pathogen-free water; the ledger accounted for treatment, evaporation, drinking, and heat; a fresh process reproduced the final state and events; rejected envelopes made no material change.

limitations: The controller is scripted and this receipt makes no LLM-policy competence claim.
The donor comparison is semantic rather than raw-hash equality because the state and event schemas intentionally differ.
One physical reference vertical does not establish cross-domain reuse, scale, deployment, or real-world physical calibration.
The maturity observation is local and causes no model call or external side effect.
